b5_fx_disclosure: The EUR investor's unhedged USD / JPY / EM currency exposure is OUT OF SCOPE. Asset processes are interpreted as EUR-denominated total returns with the FX component folded into their volatility rather than modelled as a separate correlated factor. Any statement about the currency risk of a satellite is therefore NOT SUPPORTED by this model.

costs_config._spec_ref: PROJECT_META v3, Teil B.4 - own parameter class. Rationale: a 0.20 pp TER delta runs directly against a 0.124 pp portfolio-CAGR materiality gate (G1).
costs_config.blocking_note: Every value above is an UNSOURCED PLACEHOLDER of the right order of magnitude. It exists so the cost machinery is exercised and hash-tracked, NOT so cost numbers can be quoted. Because a 0.20 pp TER delta alone exceeds the 0.124 pp G1 gate, no cost-sensitive claim may be promoted until these are replaced with sourced values (KIID/PRIIPs for TER, provider factsheets for tracking difference, venue data for spreads). Phase 3 (R2E) must therefore treat TER as a SWEPT DIMENSION (0/10/20/30 bp) rather than reading these point values.

gate_reference.note: Cost deltas are reported in the same unit as the G1 gate so they can be compared directly.

extra.blocks_phase_5: gates.require_phase_pass refuses to start any phase whose predecessor acceptance is not PASS, so Phase 5 is blocked by default and this run does not lift that. Whether to proceed on the UNCALIBRATED_ASSUMPTION prior is an operator decision: PROJECT_META's PARTIAL branch contemplates Phases 5 and 6 running with the remaining satellites left INDETERMINATE_BY_CONSTRUCTION, but BLOCKED_NETWORK is not PARTIAL. Analytically the null tests and the mu-neutral gold claim are constructed to need no empirical mu, and their ceiling is MODEL_CONSISTENT_FINDING either way. What R3 blocks unconditionally is EMPIRICAL_SUPPORT, which only Engine A on real data can award.

cost_sourcing.phase3_urgency: Phase 3 measured a 30 bp TER difference at 5,600 EUR of real terminal wealth over 20 years, exceeding the 5,000 EUR G1 materiality gate on its own. Sourcing these values is therefore a precondition for any cost-sensitive claim, not housekeeping.
cost_sourcing.reason_unmodified: No TER value could be retrieved from an authoritative document, so config/costs.json is unchanged and remains PLACEHOLDER_NOT_SOURCED. Writing TER values recalled from model training rather than read from a PRIIPs KID would produce numbers with no source URL, no retrieval date and no content hash - indistinguishable from the placeholders already there, but falsely dressed as sourced. PROJECT_META forbids exactly that.
cost_sourcing.tracking_difference_note: Tracking difference is not disclosed in a PRIIPs KID. It must be derived from published fund NAV history against the licensed index series, or taken from an issuer TD disclosure. Deriving it requires the index history, which is the same licence blocker as CORE.

fx_config._spec_ref: PROJECT_META v3, Teil B.5 - an explicit decision is MANDATORY; silent omission is disallowed.
fx_config.cost_borne: The EUR investor's unhedged USD / JPY / EM currency exposure is OUT OF SCOPE. Asset processes are interpreted as EUR-denominated total returns with the FX component folded into their volatility rather than modelled as a separate correlated factor. Any statement about the currency risk of a satellite is therefore NOT SUPPORTED by this model.
fx_config.mandatory_disclosure: This decision MUST be restated verbatim in every result report, per B.5.
fx_config.rationale: No FX process is modelled. The only claim this project still tests (Phase 6, GOLD downside) is mu-neutral by pre-registration and rests exclusively on second moments and tax mechanics. An FX process would require a correlation structure between currency and asset returns that is subject to the same underdetermination as G6, and would therefore add model uncertainty without making the claim more decidable.

inflation_config.note: B.2: the Basiszins is a function of the modelled short rate, floored at 0.

tax_config._spec_ref: PROJECT_META v3, Teil B.1-B.3. Every assumption carries an explicit legal_status.

abgeltungsteuer.assumption_note: 25% Abgeltungsteuer (§32d Abs.1 EStG) plus 5.5% Solidaritaetszuschlag on the tax amount. Soli is modelled as fully applicable to Kapitalertragsteuer (the 2021 Soli reduction does not extend to Abgeltungsteuer).

etc_debt_security_B3_alternative.assumption_note: Contrast variant reflecting BFH case law on §23 EStG private disposal transactions: tax-free after a one-year holding period. That case law concerns deliverable domestic constructions (Xetra-Gold), NOT this product. Computed only because B.3 requires both variants to be reported while legal_status != VERIFIED.

etc_debt_security_B3_assumed.assumption_note: IE00B4ND3602 is an Irish debt security (ETC) without a physical delivery claim. Assumed fully taxable under §20 EStG: no Teilfreistellung, no holding-period exemption. Effective ~26.375% on the gain.

b3_dual_reporting.materiality: ~26% on the gain versus 0% (alternative) - decides the GOLD claim on its own.
b3_dual_reporting.rule: While assets_tax_classes.etc_debt_security_B3_assumed.legal_status != VERIFIED, every GOLD claim MUST be computed and reported under BOTH variants. A single-variant GOLD result is not a valid deliverable.

basiszins.assumption_note: Assumption, to be checked against the annual BMF-Schreiben: 2023 ~2.55%, 2024 ~2.29%, 2025 ~2.53%, 2021/2022 negative -> floored to 0. The Basiszins is derived from the yield of long-dated German government bonds and is published at the start of each calendar year. Coupled to the modelled short rate so that an inflation regime cannot occur without a corresponding rise in the Basiszins (B.2 rationale: a deterministic Basiszins systematically understates the tax burden in inflationary worlds).

church_tax.assumption_note: §32d Abs.1 S.4-5 EStG. With q=0 and k=9%: effective 27.9951%. Sensitivity only per A.4; baseline is none.
church_tax.formula: est = (kapitalertrag - 4*q) / (4 + k_percent); total = est * (1 + soli + k)

freistellungsauftrag.assumption_note: Sparer-Pauschbetrag §20 Abs.9 EStG, 1000 EUR since 2023 (single filer). Modelled as nominally constant over the whole horizon - NOT indexed to inflation. This is a conservative, explicitly stated modelling choice: in a high-inflation world the real value of the FSA decays.

legal_status_vocabulary.NOT_IN_DECISION_PATH: Implemented and tested, but not exercised by any decision-path run. Must not gate.
legal_status_vocabulary.TO_BE_VERIFIED: Modelled assumption, plausible, NOT yet checked against primary source. Blocks promotion above MODEL_CONSISTENT_FINDING for any claim it materially drives.
legal_status_vocabulary.VERIFIED: Checked against primary legal source; citation recorded.

teilfreistellung.assumption_note: §20 InvStG: 30% partial exemption for private investors in equity funds (>=51% equity). Applied to both Vorabpauschale and realised gains.

vorabpauschale.assumption_note: §18 InvStG (Basisertrag = NAV_start_of_year * 0.7 * Basiszins, capped at the Wertsteigerung of the year, floored at 0, reduced by 1/12 per full month preceding the acquisition month) and §19 InvStG (accumulated Vorabpauschalen reduce the gain on disposal, preventing double taxation). An ETC is a debt security, not an Investmentfonds, so no Vorabpauschale applies to GOLD under either tax variant.

withholding_tax_credit.action: Code and hand-checks are retained and still execute in the test suite, but are DECOUPLED from every gate. No gate may depend on this branch.
withholding_tax_credit.known_v2_defect: The v2 implementation applied credit = min(swht, dt) against 26.375% rather than against 25% Einkommensteuer with Solidaritaetszuschlag applied afterwards. This is the defect that held R2 at FAIL_LEGAL_EXACTNESS. It is corrected in the retained code, but the correction is NOT a decision-path claim.
withholding_tax_credit.rationale: Accumulating Irish funds suffer foreign withholding tax at fund level; it is not creditable for the German private investor, and the Teilfreistellung is the statutory compensation mechanism. After DIVIDEND was reclassified to equity_fund, the universe contains no direct_stocks instrument, so no decision-path run exercises this branch.

unmodelled_boundary_conditions: Emergency fund, human capital, statutory/occupational pension, liquidity events and interim withdrawals are NOT modelled (B.6). This is a partial analysis of portfolio allocation, not financial planning.
